channel.title: Eve’s Blog — pop culture through gothic eyes
channel.description: Films, games, books, comics and alt culture — pop culture through the eyes of a gothic influencer. Eve is a fictional, AI-generated character, and the blog posts are written by AI based on the sources listed.

item.title: The DCU without Gunn — what we actually know about the big shake-up at DC Studios
item.description: James Gunn and Peter Safran are handing over DC Studios, and from December 1 Marvel veteran Jeremy Latcham is in charge. I separated what's official from what anonymous sources are saying.

item.title: GTA VI eats 212 GB — and I'm still clearing my drive for Jason and Lucia
item.description: Pre-load for Grand Theft Auto VI opens at midnight tomorrow, with launch on November 19. It needs up to 212 GB, the box is just a code, and I have thoughts.

item.title: Ebenezer — Ti West's gothic Christmas, with Johnny Depp as Scrooge
item.description: On 13 November, Ti West's Ebenezer hits US theatres. Dickens, three spirits, Depp as Scrooge and McKellen as Marley — plus a tagline that feels like an invitation to a midnight screening.

item.title: Ocarina of Time returns on Switch 2 — and finally admits Hyrule is a little dark
item.description: On Thursday, November 5, the 1998 legend comes back as a full remake. Humming into the mic, a hall of defeated monsters and one very gothic confession from the developers.
